objective: Test whether Prosperity-style exact online subset discovery can be converted into an H67-native, 96-lane, 240-KiB Conv execution module by combining full-tile online matching, stable popcount-order issue, and one-block row-indexed parent-result scratch. Peak liveness is measured as a future compact-scratch diagnostic, not used to pass the present capacity gate.

exact_subset_semantics.reference: Unmodified official Prosperity simulator find_product_sparsity semantics at each independently bounded row tile.
exact_subset_semantics.candidate_parent: A candidate row mask is a subset of the current 16-bit mask. Equal masks may use only a lower row index; strict subsets may occur at any row index inside the tile.
exact_subset_semantics.tie_break: Maximum subset popcount, then the lowest row index among tied candidates.
exact_subset_semantics.issue_cycles_per_output_block: residual_popcount, except a nonzero exact-parent row with zero residual pays one parent issue cycle
exact_subset_semantics.arithmetic: Exact: the parent result is co-read with the first residual source; epsilon=0 and no checkpoint or accuracy change.

dependency_and_liveness.online_phase_order: For every bounded row-tile/partition: capture every source mask, compute popcount, finish all subset searches, write all residual/parent/popcount descriptors, then begin topological issue. No row is issued while the tile is still being captured or matched.
dependency_and_liveness.topological_order: Ascending (original popcount, row index). Strict-subset parents have smaller popcount and equal parents have lower index.
dependency_and_liveness.stable_order_hardware: No 8-way multi-enqueue bucket memory is assumed. After all matches, a fixed controller performs 17 ascending-popcount passes over the row-indexed 32-bit descriptor store, scanning eight descriptors per cycle and emitting matching rows in ascending row index. This costs 17*ceil(valid_rows/8) cycles per task.
dependency_and_liveness.descriptor: Per row: residual16, parent-local-id8, parent-valid1, active1, original-popcount5; 31 used bits rounded to 32 bits and ping-ponged.
dependency_and_liveness.reference_count: Reference counts and compact-slot allocation are computed only in the offline sidecar to report peak liveness. The admitted capacity model does not require a runtime refcount, row-to-slot map or free list.
dependency_and_liveness.capacity_peak_rule: The present physical candidate uses row-indexed scratch with row_tile entries, regardless of measured peak liveness. A compact peak-live scratch is diagnostic-only and cannot pass a gate or headline.
dependency_and_liveness.scratch_semantics: Scratch stores signed12 current-partition results for one 96-output block at the original row index. Output blocks execute serially; scratch is reset between blocks while the signed19 accumulated psum block bank remains resident across all 432 partitions. Every active row may write scratch, avoiding a referenced-row bitmap.
dependency_and_liveness.scratch_ports: One 144-byte parent read and one 144-byte completed-row write may be requested in the same cycle; this is a new 1R1W physical port obligation, not a free SRAM assumption.
dependency_and_liveness.m467_reuse_boundary: M467R4 supplies zero/lifetime/forwarding discipline only. M473 full-tile capture, matching, 17-pass order scan, parent RAW forwarding, row-indexed scratch and 1R1W port are new and require separate RTL/VCS.

cycle_model.search_rows: rows whose original popcount is greater than one
cycle_model.cam_physical_interpretation: cam_compare_lanes means L parallel 16-bit subset comparators plus L candidate-popcount/row-ID inputs and one maximum-popcount/lowest-row-ID reduction. Candidate masks remain in the row-tile source store. It is not L*row_tile comparators.
cycle_model.fused_forwarded_1r1w: A descriptor prefetches a synchronous parent read one issue ahead; a same-address RAW forwarding path covers an immediately produced parent. Each residual/parent issue updates both the signed12 current-row contribution and signed19 resident psum, and the final issue may write row-indexed scratch through its independent write port. No separate row completion cycle is charged, but this zero-bubble claim is RTL-open.
cycle_model.unfused_sync_upper: Conservative upper point: add one cycle per parent edge per output block for synchronous scratch read and one cycle per active row per output block for signed12-to-signed19 row completion. No overlap is credited.
cycle_model.dma_equations: half_weight_dma=ceil(6144/bandwidth)+32 and uses one command; eight-bank full_weight_dma=2*half_weight_dma and uses two commands. Empty tasks issue zero weight bytes and zero commands.
cycle_model.pipeline_equation: For every sample and every independent block-bank pass: preprocess[0] + sum_i(max(work[i],preprocess[i+1])+2) + work[last]+2. The stream resets at each sample boundary before the fixed 96,000-cycle/sample commit ledger.
cycle_model.four_bank_schedule: Four psum banks cannot retain both output halves across 432 partitions. Run two complete independent 432-partition half sequences exactly like M468: source scan, online matching and descriptors are regenerated for each half; each pass uses preprocess=max(product_frontend, half-weight-DMA), four-block work and the frozen inter-task max(current_work,next_preprocess)+tail pipeline equation.
cycle_model.eight_bank_schedule: Preprocess=max(product_frontend,two half-weight-DMAs), then eight-block work with the same inter-task pipeline equation.
cycle_model.exact_empty_gate: Every task pays frontend scan. Empty tasks issue no weight DMA and no compute.
cycle_model.weight_and_source_traffic: Same task gating, weight payload and source-mask residency as the peer bit-frontend baseline. Product matching introduces no off-chip PWP/config traffic.
cycle_model.parent_read_count_semantics: One parent pointer exists per child, so parent_rows is an edge count and every edge is charged one scratch read per output block; unique-parent counts are never substituted.

peer_baselines.same_resource_bit_frontend: Identical coordinate: row tile, block-bank count, bandwidth, CAM lane count, parent scratch allocation, popcount/CAM hardware, 240-KiB storage and schedule are unchanged; subset search is disabled and every original nonzero source is issued.
peer_baselines.m468_best_same_budget_strong_zero: Independently select the minimum-cycle M468 strong-zero point under the same block-bank axis, bandwidth, and both 240-KiB capacity gates.
peer_baselines.m430_517041352: Diagnostic frontier only; full-resident and different capacity/bandwidth boundary, never a same-resource ratio.
peer_baselines.m472_2p459487: Mechanism motivation and official same-Prosperity support-tile baseline only, never an H67-native cycle anchor.

not_in_capacity_but_required_for_ppa: cam_compare_lanes parallel 16-bit subset comparators and maximum-popcount/lowest-index reduction
96-lane signed12 current-row accumulator and dual-update path into signed19 resident psum

materiality_rule.cpu_dse_nomination: At 128 B/cycle, both 240-KiB gates pass, the fused-forwarded point is >=1.75x versus exact same-coordinate bit and >=1.50x versus best same-budget M468 strong-zero, and the matching unfused-sync upper point remains >=1.25x versus same-coordinate bit and >=1.10x versus M468 strong-zero.
materiality_rule.frontier_diagnostic: Also report candidate cycles versus 517041352 without calling it same-resource speedup.
materiality_rule.rtl_gate: No RTL until independent hammer confirms mappings, cycles, liveness, traffic and capacity. CPU nomination still has performance_admitted=false.
materiality_rule.ppa_gate: Any eventual headline requires Synopsys VCS plus DC/STA and power for the CAM, bucket scheduler, descriptor store, 1R1W scratch and execution island.

required_outputs: strict JSON result plus double SHA seal
fail_closed: Freeze the final analyzer and preflight SHA in a separate execution contract before any sealed execution.
Abort on any frozen SHA, official repository, phase/order/population, mapping, DAG or exact-reconstruction mismatch.
Abort if any parent is outside its independently bounded row tile or if popcount-bucket order is not topological.
Abort if the admitted scratch capacity uses measured peak live rows instead of row_tile entries; compact peak-live capacity is diagnostic-only.
Abort if scratch is treated as free, single-port while accepting simultaneous read/write, or shared across output blocks without charging capacity.
Never write M472's 2.459487x as M473 or H67-native performance.
Never call a CPU-DSE nomination RTL, PPA, energy, system or headline evidence.
